question_or_proposition: For TDS Net Increase effluent limits cross-referenced to footnote *11, during Federal FY2025, do the numeric limits associated with footnote *11 (rather than those associated with footnote *10) govern enforceable compliance comparison, and from what date within that fiscal year, given the permit effective date, the three-year commencement in footnote *11, the permit expiration date, and any administrative continuation described in footnote *11?
required_context: whether the permit was administratively continued during Federal FY2025
dates of reported TDS Net Increase measurements within Federal FY2025
notes: Footnote *11 defines a post-three-year applicability window for a second set of TDS Net Increase numeric limits, distinct from the footnote *10 limits that apply from the effective date through three years. Resolving when the *11 limits govern during FY2025 would change which enforceable numeric limits apply to reported measurements and thus compliance evaluation under Purpose A.
